_rationale: 80/20 allocation (blended 8.6%) vs the equivalent 60/40 balanced-realistic scenario (blended ~6.5%). Higher expected return should push probability above the balanced-realistic range. However higher stock volatility (15% stddev) widens outcomes. Probability expected in the 35-80% range — better than balanced-realistic but with more spread. Bracket inflation indexing (post-2026 brackets inflate with scenario rate) slightly reduces tax drag in late years, shifting the probability up slightly versus the frozen-bracket model.
